dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: People used to call this place "Downriver," because the villagers apparently moved here from a place called "Upriver."

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: With them, they brought their knowledge of fishing which had been passed down from generation to generation. I learned a lot from them when I was here.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Now, Upriver is long gone and Downriver is all but deserted. It won't be long before no one even remembers what these places are called.
